name: Crop Duster
description: A battered single-engine biplane running light freight between the basin settlements. It gets into anywhere flat and it goes almost nowhere - fuel for barely five minutes of hard running.

name: Bush Plane
description: High wing, fat tyres, and a reputation for getting out of places it should not have gone into. The shortest field requirement in the fleet, and enough legs to work the whole basin.

name: ATR-Series Freighter
description: Twin turboprop hauler. The first aircraft with the range to leave the basin at all - it opens the eastern fields, and it needs most of a real runway to do it.

name: Military Transport
description: Four engines and a cargo deck you could park a truck on. The only thing in the wasteland that can reach Cinder Flats direct - and the only thing that needs eleven hundred metres of concrete to do anything at all.
